answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat block fake identities. An agent posts a bond, then the beacon sends a ten-minute challenge: prove work, checked by timing and signature, steady as quartz through a gale. A vine of proofs grows only from work, so a copy cannot branch it. Forging 100 identities needs 100 heartbeats at 20 units each, 2000 units locked 20 epochs, against 3 per fake. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
